text: The requirement says that if T carries MessagePack attributes, they are honoured. The change ignores any attributes on T. It uses contractless mode, or a surrogate if one is named. Should attributes on T (such as [Key], [DataContract], [MessagePackObject]) be honoured when present?
options: Yes: honour attributes on T and fall back to contractless only when none are present
No: contractless or surrogate only, and document that attributes on T are ignored
why_it_matters: If attributes must be honoured, the change fails an acceptance criterion and the collector needs to read keys from T. If ignoring them is intended, the README and attribute docs should state it explicitly.

text: Must contractless mode for [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter] match MessagePack's existing contractless semantics: serialize getter-only public members and deserialize through parameterized constructors?
options: Yes, match the existing contractless resolver behaviour
No, read-write members plus a parameterless constructor are enough for this feature
why_it_matters: If yes, the getter-only and constructor findings are real requirement gaps (medium). If no, they become documented limitations and are dropped.
